# josebatista.dev

> A personal developer portfolio presented as an interactive Linux desktop, by José Batista.

josebatista.dev is a developer portfolio styled as a Linux operating-system desktop. It showcases the author's bio, software projects, technical writing, and contact links, with a focus on software engineering, data processing, streaming, and observability. The site is built with VitePress and Vue 3 and uses a dark, terminal-inspired theme. Content is available in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

## Languages

- [English](https://josebatista.dev/en/): English version of the site.
- [Português](https://josebatista.dev/pt/): Brazilian Portuguese version of the site.

## Main Sections

- [Home — English](https://josebatista.dev/en/): The interactive desktop entry point in English.
- [Início — Português](https://josebatista.dev/pt/): The interactive desktop entry point in Portuguese.
- [About — English](https://josebatista.dev/en/about): Biography and background of José Batista.
- [Sobre — Português](https://josebatista.dev/pt/about): Biografia e trajetória de José Batista.
- [Projects — English](https://josebatista.dev/en/projects): Software projects with descriptions, languages, and star counts.
- [Projetos — Português](https://josebatista.dev/pt/projects): Projetos de software com descrições, linguagens e número de estrelas.
- [Contact — English](https://josebatista.dev/en/contact): Links to reach the author.
- [Contato — Português](https://josebatista.dev/pt/contact): Links para entrar em contato com o autor.

## Blog Posts — English

- [A five-minute error alert isn't just a counter](https://josebatista.dev/en/posts/flink101-02): Tracking a service's errors in real time helps explain state and windows without starting with an API.
- [When data never ends: why streaming is different from batch](https://josebatista.dev/en/posts/flink101-01): A first step toward understanding the problem that tools like Apache Flink solve.
- [Hello, world!](https://josebatista.dev/en/posts/hello-world): An introduction to the blog, the work behind it, and the topics the author plans to explore.

## Posts do blog — Português

- [Um alerta de erros em cinco minutos não é só um contador](https://josebatista.dev/pt/posts/flink101-02): Acompanhar erros de um serviço em tempo real ajuda a entender state e janelas sem começar por uma API.
- [Quando os dados não acabam: por que streaming é diferente de batch](https://josebatista.dev/pt/posts/flink101-01): Um primeiro passo para entender o problema que ferramentas como o Apache Flink resolvem.
- [Olá, mundo!](https://josebatista.dev/pt/posts/hello-world): Uma apresentação do blog, do trabalho por trás dele e dos assuntos que o autor pretende explorar.
